native_memory_completion.MD_failure_policy: Native aggregate completion may consume children before returning an error; retain the owner and never replay that preparation. Mock APIs explicitly preserving the full preparation may retry.

adapter_recovery.proof: Nub incarnation receives immutable recovery admission only after a read-only query of the retained owned mapper confirms actual context ownership and detached root under BCR/fabric proof. Query runs outside role/Family gates.
adapter_recovery.fault_route: Current client+controller epoch validated under nub lock; route+admission epoch validated by ConnectorFence before closing admission and scheduling the ordinary role worker.
adapter_recovery.ordinary_and_ISO_cleanup: Only actual DMA cleanup failures are retried, once per failed owner, after root proof; command completion is not repeated. Invariant and uncertain Native enqueue failures remain pinned.
adapter_recovery.Device_contextless_cleanup: Drain nodes that have already delivered their Native error callback, without dereferencing or invoking the old tag/aggregate.
adapter_recovery.Device_stop: Drain remaining work before joining/cancelling worker handles; recheck permanent pin after join and Family stop; refuse reuse of an existing State.
adapter_recovery.Host_stop: Recover eligible ordinary/ISO payload cleanup before quiesce waits; preserve existing data/copy parameters and original completer ordering.
adapter_recovery.pins: Retain once under IRQ-safe lock, publish pin after retain, and release outside locks only after complete teardown. Native MD completion errors and persistent cleanup/invariant failures stay pinned and veto sleep.
adapter_recovery.owned_type_check: Both retirement query and command-record acknowledgement require OSDynamicCast(QcomUSBMapper, mapper); foreign IOMapper responses cannot authorize recovery.
